citations.quote: This self-reinforcing process can lead to a downward spiral in asset prices and the net worth of market participants.
Under certain conditions, margins are destabilizing, and market liquidity and funding liquidity are mutually reinforcing, leading to liquidity spirals.
Such a “fire sale” could create a chain reaction that spreads to related asset classes, possibly even creating the perception of risk at the asset manager level.

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Funding liquidity (traders' capital/margin) and market liquidity (price impact of trading) are two sides of one coin: a shock to either raises margins, forces deleveraging, and triggers self-reinforcing fire-sale spirals with cross-asset commonality.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Funding & Market-Liquidity Spirals and Fire Sales
